title: EEG Pre/Post Intervention Dataset
description: This dataset comprises EEG recordings from a pre/post intervention study investigating neural activity changes across multiple participant groups. The data are organized according to the Brain Imaging Data Structure (BIDS) specification and include pre-intervention and post-intervention sessions for each participant, enabling comparative analysis of intervention effects on electrophysiological measures.
methods_description: EEG data were recorded using standard acquisition systems. Recordings are organized by participant and session (pre/post intervention), with detailed acquisition parameters provided in JSON sidecar files accompanying each EEG recording.
